about: Audit C3 (2026-09-25). recognized: the first candidate whose comCode maps through kuaidi100Code or kuaidi100CodeAliases; unrecognized: no such candidate (the paid stage decides); failure: retryable, counts one network failure and never reaches the paid stage. The repository holds no raw captured autoComNum body; documented cases are the reduced shapes the records quote.
